purpose: Qualify one bounded Dell reference-vertical RAG corpus before MCP and multi-agent integration. This policy does not grant Evidence or NumericFact authority.

candidate_policy.prose_leaf_lane: structured chunks where contains_table is false and visible text remains after image-reference removal
candidate_policy.table_leaf_lane: every atomic structured block where block_kind is table
candidate_policy.image_lane: catalog only; excluded until a research-material image asset is captured, hashed and manually qualified

bm25.tokenizer: lowercase Unicode word and financial-symbol tokenizer v1

dense.parent_projection: Embed retrieval leaves only; rank parent sections by the maximum cosine score of their child leaves, preserving parent-child lineage without truncating whole sections.
dense.query_instruction:
Instruct: Given a source-bound financial research request, retrieve passages or tables that directly address the requested evidence facet while preserving issuer, period, source role and relationship direction.
Query:

token_budget_basis.node_purpose: Embed the frozen Dell retrieval candidates and 33 frozen development queries for local semantic candidate ranking; no generation or evidence promotion.
token_budget_basis.input_scale: 684 expected retrieval leaves and 33 queries; 135 parent sections are projected from child scores rather than embedded whole. Actual token and truncation counts must be receipted.
token_budget_basis.required_output: One normalized 1024-dimensional vector per candidate and query plus full rankings.
token_budget_basis.schema_burden: Dense float matrix, model identity, serialization digest, token counts, truncation counts and CUDA receipt.
token_budget_basis.materiality_quality_risk: 512-token truncation can hide table rows or late-chunk evidence; dense is a challenger and must not displace stronger lexical recall without human review.
token_budget_basis.comparable_run_evidence: The 0.6B model passed a one-machine qualification smoke on the local RTX 4060; malformed-prompt attempt is preserved and excluded from selection.
token_budget_basis.reasoning_profile: Non-generative normalized embedding inference using the official Qwen query serialization.
token_budget_basis.stop_truncation_behavior: Hard truncate leaves at 1,024 tokens as a measured bounded preview; record every truncated node/query and do not interpret a truncation-driven miss as missing source data. Long atomic tables remain available to BM25 and parent/locator delivery.

hybrid.weight_selection_basis: Bounded development-set correction after official Qwen query formatting: lexical retrieval was materially stronger on exact issuer, fiscal-period and accounting-table language; dense remains a challenger signal. This is not a blind-holdout or general-product claim.

reranker.implementation: Qwen3 official yes/no causal-LM scoring surface
reranker.instruction: Judge whether the source-bound financial passage or table materially satisfies the research request. Prefer the exact company, metric, period, relationship direction and source role; reject topic-only co-mentions and issuer or period mismatches.

token_budget_basis.node_purpose: Rerank the top 32 BM25-heavy hybrid candidates for each of 33 frozen queries with the official Qwen3 yes/no scoring surface.
token_budget_basis.input_scale: Up to 1,056 query-candidate pairs; actual pair, batch, token and truncation counts must be receipted.
token_budget_basis.required_output: One finite relevance logit difference per pair and a deterministic reordered candidate list.
token_budget_basis.schema_burden: Full pair count, candidate depth, model identity, input token/truncation counts, finite-score check and CUDA receipt.
token_budget_basis.materiality_quality_risk: Issuer, fiscal-period and table-role near misses are common; reranking cannot recover a candidate absent from the hybrid top 32.
token_budget_basis.comparable_run_evidence: A real single-pair local smoke completed on the RTX 4060 at approximately 1.24 GB peak allocated memory before the full preview.
token_budget_basis.reasoning_profile: Non-generative causal-LM yes/no relevance scoring; no free-form answer generation.
token_budget_basis.stop_truncation_behavior: Hard truncate formatted pairs to the 2,048-token budget; record truncation count, fail on non-finite or missing scores, and never silently lower candidate depth after failure.

evaluation.manual_review_scope: top 10 for every local and external diagnostic query, including every miss, hard-negative appearance, all critical queries, raw chunk/table/locator inspection, and local-substitution risk for external-only facets
